headline: Alisal Union partners with Monterey County Behavioral Health to provide mental health services.
summary: On Oct. 7, the Alisal Union School District Board approved, 4-1, an agreement with Monterey County Behavioral Health's Rainbow Connections Program to increase on-campus LGBTQ+ mental health services for no cost to students and their families.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
